description: Lists the workspace’s contact fields, the keys a contact’s attributes can hold, one page at a time: each field’s key, label, type (text, number, date, boolean or choice), its choices, whether it is required, and how many contacts hold a value for it. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: list_contact_fields
title: Read the contact fields
